description: Teaching contract documentation, not executable JSON Schema. Shared Python functions implement validation.

required_fields.requests: nonnegative whole-number text within signed int64 range
required_fields.p95_latency_ms: finite nonnegative number, or blank when unavailable

policies.conflicting_keys: raise error; investigate rather than choose a version
policies.missing_latency: retain row for workload totals; omit only from latency-specific calculations
policies.outlier: flag using 1.5 IQR fences for investigation, never automatically delete
policies.incomplete_calendar: report supplied dates only; never infer zero workload for absent dates
policies.arithmetic: Combined requests must fit signed int64 so grouped sums remain exact; otherwise validation stops.
